summary: A team renames the CA files to CR, extracts the advice they contain into conceptual units of infrastructure as the constitution defines, and outputs the units to records/commander/advice/<unit>/.
statement: Filter through the CA records with a team. These are actually now CR records, rename them as such. The CA is contained within the document, It is not necessarily designated with a prefix. Intelligently extract these CA into their conceptual units as per the commanders intent in the constitution. Read the cockpit.constitution document and output them into the new infrastructure shape records/commander/advice/<unit>/
brief: The second migration order, given with CO-085. It concerns the five files the commander wrote on his desk in answer to the pilot's dossiers and requests; under the constitution those are responses, and the advice they hold is a separate kind of record grouped by the piece of infrastructure it shapes.
